Native to southern Indochina, from southern (peninsular) Thailand, throughout Peninsular Malaysia, Singapore, and the Greater Sunda Islands of Sumatra, Borneo, and Java.

A typical habitat of B. hasselti is the coastal heath forest at Rantau Abang, Terengganu state, Peninsular Malaysia, which consists of small water channels flowing slowly through stands of vegetation composed mostly of a Melaleuca species (myrtle).
